title: §8-24: Ice maker kit electrical (E ID / E IU)

source.oemTestTitle: Ice maker tray sensor / kit electrical

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the refrigerator before servicing electrical parts. R-600a is flammable — follow sealed-system precautions for CH/CL codes.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing. R-600a refrigerant precautions apply.

steps.title: E ID or E IU displayed?
steps.body: E ID = ice tray sensor short/open; E IU = ice maker kit motor, gear, hall IC, or heater open.
steps.sourceExcerpt: E ID = ice tray sensor short/open; E IU = ice maker kit motor, gear, hall IC, or heater open.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Ice maker electrical fault not displayed.

steps.title: Ice maker harness and test switch
steps.body: Verify ice maker connector seating. Press I/M test switch — ice should drop when kit healthy. Check tray sensor and kit resistance per §8-24.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Verify ice maker connector seating. Press I/M test switch — ice should drop when kit healthy. Check tray sensor and kit resistance per §8-24.

steps.title: Replace ice maker parts
steps.oemOutcome: Replace tray sensor (E ID) or complete ice maker kit (E IU) per OEM parts table.

steps.title: No ice maker fault
steps.oemOutcome: Ice maker electrical path not faulting.
